first_response: IAF airlift from 17 Jun; 12,000+ stranded at Badrinath by 18 Jun
operation_span: Evacuation 17-30 Jun (~2 weeks); body search into Sep
people_rescued: 110,000+ evacuated (IAF airlifted 18,424 in 2,137 sorties; ITBP 33,009 in 15 days)
notes: By 21 Jun: Army 10,000 soldiers + 11 helicopters, IAF 43 aircraft, Navy 45 divers. A Mi-17 returning from Kedarnath crashed on 25 Jun, killing 20 (incl. 9 NDRF, 6 ITBP).

first_response: Same day; mud over 5 km slowed teams reaching Bastadi
operation_span: Most sites wound up by 4-5 Jul; Bastadi search continued
notes: After day 1 it was recovery, not rescue: bodies (and a few animals alive) dug out with JCBs and dog squads. 240 people in relief camps on day 4.

first_response: Delayed by damage; the CM could not land due to rain
notes: Forces on site by 16 Aug: SDRF 30, SSB 41, Army 24, ITBP 2.

first_response: ITBP, NDRF and SDRF dispatched the same day
people_rescued: 10 injured rescued at Sanel; injured airlifted to Dehradun
notes: Air support was the bottleneck: two helicopters crashed within four days and flights were suspended.

first_response: 10 SDRF + 20 revenue police on site on day 1
notes: Small team for a remote village; locals did much of the digging.

first_response: ITBP 1st Bn Joshimath troops rushed out soon after
operation_span: 12 rescued from the smaller Tapovan tunnel that evening after ~4 h; search ran to May
notes: NDRF teams flown in on 2 C-130J. By May 2021, 83 bodies recovered of 204 missing.

first_response: SDRF; all stranded rescued by morning
notes: No deaths. Shows that most requests can be low severity.

first_response: Ground rescue from the morning of 1 Aug (~5,000 that day); IAF Chinook + Mi-17 from 2 Aug
notes: Weather grounded the Chinook on day 4 (Mi-17: 60 people in 3 sorties). Most people walked out with SDRF/NDRF.

first_response: Army Harsil (~4 km) mobilised 150 within 10 min; ITBP 16-member team from 12th Bn reached the same day
operation_span: Rescue still running on 13 Aug (SDRF command post)
people_rescued: 15-20 on day 1; 150 by 6 Aug; 1,308 by 13 Aug
notes: The army camp was itself hit. Bad weather halted helicopters. 68 missing on 13 Aug.
